changelog:
Initial release of oneperson: your personal AI assistant platform.

- Supports multi-agent orchestration for complex tasks
- Provides autonomous task management and workflow execution
- Enables building reusable automated pipelines
- Includes memory for persistent context across sessions
- Requires ONEPERSON_API_KEY for setup and usage
summary: Your personal AI assistant platform — multi-agent orchestration, task management, and autonomous workflow execution.
